process_exit_contract: PASS requires TEST_PASSED, a normal make exit, and no TEST_FAILED marker. TEST_FAILED without TEST_PASSED remains FAIL even when make exits nonzero. Conflicting markers, an abnormal exit after TEST_PASSED and a cycle-limit marker are FAIL. Interrupted execution and a log without the Verilator command are INVALID.
comparison: self-checking directed programs observing the fast-interrupt-redirect claim id through a mailbox exit code (0xff pass, 0x01 fail), followed by a standalone check of the synchronizer output on gw_clk and reset transitions
test_scope: The runner requires both programs to pass in separate simulations: high physical requests select handler 7; low physical requests select handler 6. The low-request program checks the selected handler without executing mret. The port probe, with rawclk tied to gw_clk and clken high, requires dout to equal din from two rising edges earlier and to clear on asynchronous reset.
